readback.command: chat message list-direct --open-dingtalk-id <CLI-returned R2 bot ID> --time <start> --forward false --limit 3 --format json
readback.runtimePolicy: One bounded readback after accepted dispatch. Save query response hash/count, but do not infer delivery from the empty/unverified history schema. Await user-client acceptance; never resend.

sendResponse.reason: No real send was authorized in this implementation/review turn
sendResponse.parserPolicy: Extract an unambiguous processQueryKey only if present in actual CLI JSON; record its field path and whole-response SHA256. Do not require success=true or assume result.processQueryKey. An explicit error prevents acceptance classification.

checks: signed URL expiry at preparation and dispatch
imageHosting.dependency: Configured QQ account/API and temporary COS raw_url; effective signature may last about one hour, not permanent hosting

accountPreflight.timing: Live identity recheck immediately before the only DWS send, after image preparation
accountPreflight.oldCLI: Do not pass --profile; contact user get-self must match target.corpId and target.accountUserId
accountPreflight.modernCLI: get-self and the sole active current entry from profile list must agree with target; always pass deterministic corpId:accountUserId, even if target.profile was omitted
accountPreflight.mismatchOrQueryFailure: Zero DingTalk sends, no account switch and no fallback

controlledCLI.privateConfigMode: 0600 or stricter, owned by current user
controlledCLI.retryPolicy: Any existing matching receipt is returned without sending again; UNKNOWN/INFLIGHT/accepted are never replayed. No invented UUID flag.
controlledCLI.receiptPolicy: Independent dingtalk channel, target/account/org/bot digest, manifest and image hashes, provider receipt and readback evidence; no credentials, signed URLs or raw message bodies
